title: Floor Layers, Except Carpet, Wood, and Hard Tiles
description: Apply blocks, strips, or sheets of shock-absorbing, sound-deadening, or decorative coverings to floors.

tasks.text: Inspect surface to be covered to ensure that it is firm and dry.
Measure and mark guidelines on surfaces or foundations, using chalk lines and dividers.
Determine traffic areas and decide location of seams.
Sweep, scrape, sand, or chip dirt and irregularities to clean base surfaces, correcting imperfections that may show through the covering.
Cut flooring material to fit around obstructions.
Trim excess covering materials, tack edges, and join sections of covering material to form tight joint.
Form a smooth foundation by stapling plywood or Masonite over the floor or by brushing waterproof compound onto surface and filling cracks with plaster, putty, or grout to seal pores.
Cut covering and foundation materials, according to blueprints and sketches.
Roll and press sheet wall and floor covering into cement base to smooth and finish surface, using hand roller.
Apply adhesive cement to floor or wall material to join and adhere foundation material.
Lay out, position, and apply shock-absorbing, sound-deadening, or decorative coverings to floors, walls, and cabinets, following guidelines to keep courses straight and create designs.
Remove excess cement to clean finished surface.
Heat and soften floor covering materials to patch cracks or fit floor coverings around irregular surfaces, using blowtorch.
Disconnect and remove appliances, light fixtures, and worn floor and wall covering from floors, walls, and cabinets.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Web page creation and editing software
skills.def: Software to develop or edit web sites or individual pages. Examples: Facebook.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Aya Associates Comp-U-Floor, Flooring Technologies QFloors, Focus Floor Covering Software, Textile Management Systems RollMaster.

skills.name: Project management software
skills.def: Software to plan, organize, staff, or control the completion of a product or set of tasks. Examples: CPR Software FloorCOST Estimator for Excel, Measure Square FloorEstimate Pro, On Center On-Screen Takeoff, Pacific Solutions FloorRight.

skills.name: Computer aided design CAD software
skills.def: Software to design 2D or 3D objects. May include engineering or architectural features. Examples: Project visualization software.

skills.name: Inventory management software
skills.def: Software to maintain the inventory of businesses including restaurants or retail shops. Examples: Radio frequency identification RFID software.
